name: bjj-tracker
description: BJJ belt progression tracker with video demonstrations and IBJJF rules

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html styles.css data.js videos.js app.js manifest.webmanifest sw.js icon-*.png www/
scripts.ios:init: npm run build && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
